H_hierarchical.evidence: The paper lists a flat set of conditions: system on, Keadaan 1-4, and Stop; no parent state or nested sub-FSM is described.

G_guards_arith.evidence: Transitions depend on limit switches, counters, encoder thresholds, and a Boolean stop condition: LS2 counter = 2, D100 = 1380 ppr, D100 counter = 4, D200 = 5520 ppr, and LS3 or PB stop.

A_actions_nontrivial.evidence: Each state commands concrete actuator motion: vertical motor clockwise/up, vertical motor reverse/down, horizontal motor left, horizontal motor right, with states switched off/on by counters and sensors.

F_fault_recovery.evidence: The controller has a dedicated shutdown path: if Keadaan 4 hits limit switch 3 or PB stop is pressed, the whole system turns off.

T1_cross_section_element.evidence: State names, actions, and transition guards are all concentrated in Section 2.2.2 around Figure 7, not split across distant sections.

T2_implicit_domain_term.evidence: Terms such as limit switch, counter, and PB stop are used, but the paper spells out the resulting transition rules directly.

T3_implicit_action_from_prose.evidence: The state list directly maps Keadaan 1-4 to motor direction/actions in the same subsection as the transition explanation.

T4_multivar_arith_guard.evidence: The shutdown guard combines two inputs with Boolean OR: limit switch 3 or PB stop causes the whole system to turn off.

T5_composite_internal_behavior.evidence: No composite state exists, so no parent entry/during/exit behavior is present.

T6_global_cross_cutting_recovery.evidence: PB stop shuts the system off, but the paper does not explicitly state a from-any-state global recovery rule.

C1_speculative_dfs.evidence: No composite state or init pseudo-chain is described.

C2_expr_ir_smt.evidence: There is one clear Boolean-composed guard, plus several counter/threshold guards, but not three arithmetic+Boolean guard formulas.

C3_forced_and_aspect.evidence: No explicit cross-cutting rule over three or more substates and no parent during monitor is specified.

C4_abstract_action.evidence: Outputs are concrete PLC/motor/HMI effects rather than effector-agnostic notifications, logs, or publications.

key_nl_quotes: Kondisi-kondisi tersebut adalah: Sistem menyala; Keadaan 1 motor vertikal ... bergerak ke atas; Keadaan 2 ... bergerak ke bawah; Keadaan 3 ... bergerak ke kiri; Keadaan 4 ... bergerak ke kanan; Stop.

Sistem akan berulang ... hingga counter dari limit switch 2 telah aktif sebanyak 2 kali ... Keadaan 3 hingga D100 bernilai 1380 ppr ... D100 aktif sebanyak 4 kali ... D200 mencapai nilai 5520 ppr ... limit switch 3 atau PB stop ditekan maka seluruh sistem akan off.
one_line_pitch: A flat but sensor- and counter-gated PLC painting sequence that stresses guard and actuator-action extraction through encoder thresholds, loop counters, and shutdown conditions.
rationale: The sample is a meaningful EFSM benchmark because the behavior is dominated by guarded transitions over sensors, counters, and encoder registers, with concrete motor actions on every operational state. It also contains a dedicated stop/off condition. However, it has no hierarchy, no composite behavior, and only modest pyfcstm-specific advantage, so it is better as a backup stress-test case than a top candidate.
